svg.title: IR Distance Sensors
svg.desc: A RoboLore instructional graphic showing the Zumo's right, front, and left IR distance sensors and the direction each sensor faces. Robot photograph copyright Pololu Corporation (pololu.com), reproduced with attribution. Labels and layout by RoboLore.
svg.text: IR Distance Sensors
right, front, and left sensors face in three different directions
Each sensor watches a different part of the robot’s surroundings
so the Zumo can detect obstacles across its front field of view.
SENSOR DIRECTIONS
Three sensors cover the robot’s right side, front, and left side
The side sensors point outward while the center sensor points straight ahead.
Right IR Sensor
Right-side coverage
Detects obstacles on the robot’s right side
before they move into the center of its path.
Front IR Sensor
Straight-ahead coverage
Provides the most direct reading for obstacles
located immediately in front of the robot.
Left IR Sensor
Left-side coverage
Detects obstacles on the robot’s left side
and completes the three-direction sensor view.
i
Tip:
Together, the three sensors give the Zumo right, center, and left obstacle coverage.
Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com
